units.sentence: Georgia lawmakers ban school-day phone use in public high schools by July 1, 2027
units.evidence_span: Beginning no later than July 1, 2027, no public school student in grades nine through 12 shall be permitted to access personal electronic devices during the school day
units.problem: Fine for a headline: 'by' keeps 'no later than'. Minor: 'phone use' is narrower than the law's 'access' to any personal electronic device (P-003, P-004).

framing_issues.text: Georgia lawmakers ban school-day phone use in public high schools by July 1, 2027
framing_issues.issue: 'Phone use' understates the rule, which bars access (holding, wearing or using, P-003) to any personal electronic device, including smartwatches, tablets and headphones (P-004). That is acceptable in a headline, but the link text repeats the phone-only framing.
